neighbors.establishing_passage: A training-free concept channel probe (CCP) method ... turning off the channels tied to one finding, that finding's score collapses while unrelated labels stay stable. Models probed are Pillar-0 and Merlin, not CT-CLIP; mosaic attenuation and vessel caliber are not addressed.
Probes the resulting representations using interpretability techniques, assessing whether the model captures spatially meaningful signals despite lacking segmentation labels.

In small airways disease and pulmonary vascular disease, the pulmonary vessels within the lucent regions of lung are small relative to the vessels in the more opaque lung ... In infiltrative diseases, the vessels are more uniform in size.

Finds Sybil behaves as a linear model with pairwise interactions over nodule presence/absence, ties its baseline term to age via global cues like bone density, and exposes fixation on ECG electrodes and metal snaps used to close a hospital gown. Fissures are not examined.

No vessel-centerline geometry; Merlin used as benchmark, not probed model.

The presence of accessory renal arteries and renal artery branches was higher in the diagnosed hypertension group ... independent factors of hypertension. Branching anatomy on CT, not tortuosity, no model.

Mean arterial tortuosity index was higher in patients over 60 years old, in those with arterial aneurysms, and in those diagnosed with hypertension. Carotid/systemic beds; retinal Grad-CAM analog attributes hypertension prediction to vessel bifurcations.

ADN first performs asymmetry disentanglement based on input NCCTs, which produces different types of 3D asymmetry maps ... bilateral symmetric comparison of brain hemispheres is usually used to locate pathological abnormalities. Parenchymal asymmetry, not venous.

The cortical vein opacification score (COVES) quantifies venous opacification on CTA, with scores ranging from 0 to 6 ... Patients with favorable tissue-level collaterals likely have robust cortical venous outflow. Contrast-opacification phenomenon only.
